# The Verge

> The Verge is a leading technology news and reviews publication covering consumer electronics, AI, policy, science, and entertainment with in-depth analysis and product testing.

The Verge provides comprehensive coverage of major tech companies (Apple, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Samsung), emerging technologies like artificial intelligence and smart home devices, and the regulatory landscape shaping the tech industry. The site combines breaking news, expert reviews, and investigative journalism across hardware, software, and policy domains.

- Google

## Core News & Analysis

- [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com): The Verge homepage: technology news, reviews, and investigations.
- [Tech | The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech): Tech section covering hardware, apps, and news from Google, Apple, Amazon.
- [Science | The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/science): Science news covering health, environment, and AI technology breakthroughs.
- [Business | The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/business): Business coverage: tech industry trends, corporate strategy, innovation.

## Product Reviews & Buying Guides

- [Reviews | The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/reviews): Product reviews and buying guides for phones, laptops, headphones, and gear.
- [Phone Reviews | The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/phone-review): Smartphone reviews and comparisons for flagship and budget phones.
- [Tablet Reviews | The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tablet-review): Tablet reviews: iPad, Fire tablets, and Samsung Galaxy devices.
- [Headphone Reviews | The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/headphone-review): Headphone and earbud reviews: wireless, noise-cancelling, buying guides.
- [Smart Home Reviews | The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/smart-home-review): Smart home device reviews: thermostats, speakers, security systems.

## AI & Emerging Technology

- [Artificial Intelligence | The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence): AI coverage including ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, and AI ethics.
- [Policy | The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/policy): Tech policy analysis: platform regulation, free speech, content moderation.

## Major Tech Companies

- [Apple | The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/apple): Apple news: iPhone, iPad, MacBook, and ecosystem updates.
- [Google | The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/google): Google news: Pixel, Chrome, Android, Gmail, and product updates.
- [Amazon | The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/amazon): Amazon coverage: Prime, Kindle, Fire devices, and company developments.
- [Microsoft | The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/microsoft): Microsoft coverage: Windows, Azure, Xbox, Copilot, and Office.
- [Samsung | The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/samsung): Samsung news: Galaxy phones, foldables, and electronics.
- [Facebook | The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/facebook): Facebook and Meta coverage: social media, Instagram, WhatsApp, privacy.

## Science & Innovation

- [Space | The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/space): Space news: NASA, SpaceX, exoplanets, and commercial space industry.
- [Energy | The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/energy): Energy news: renewable energy, power grids, Tesla, climate technology.

## Entertainment & Culture

- [Entertainment | The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment): Entertainment news on gaming, movies, TV, streaming, and pop culture.
